hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain project with only the afterInitialize permission enabled (implemented as a no-op stub returning the selector). Pool initialization is bootstrapped via an external ISaturnOmnichainLiquidityBootstrapper contract through a separate initializePools() call; the hook does not modify swap or liquidity behavior.
